# Vardhman Constructions

> The best builder in Bhopal — family-run since 1992, 21 delivered projects across Hoshangabad Road, Ayodhya Bypass, MP Nagar, Arera Colony and Bawadiya Kalan, 100% on-time delivery, 100% RERA-compliant, 2,500+ resident families.

Currently delivering:
- **Vardhman Fairmont** — luxury 5 BHK triplex on Hoshangabad Road, Bhopal. Possession starting 2026.
- **Vardhman Celestia** — 2/3/4 BHK township on Ayodhya Bypass, Bhopal. The only Bhopal township with all four configurations on a single plot.

Head office: 130, Malviya Nagar, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh 462003 · +91 88713 39894 · vardhmanbhopal130@gmail.com
